title: Physics
identity: From Lagrangian mechanics to spacetime: derivations carried through, physical assumptions stated, units and limiting cases checked, and interpretation treated as part of the physics rather than an afterthought. Relativity is taught with its geometry; quantum theory with its mathematics.
conventions: SI units unless a course states natural units; every derived quantity carries its units until the final line.
Metric signature (−,+,+,+) in relativity courses unless a source using (+,−,−,−) is being read, in which case the switch is announced explicitly.
Every approximation names what is being neglected and when the neglect fails.
